name: Woven Wrap

assembly.instruction: Fold and stitch the main wrap piece along the edges.
Attach the accent strip to the main wrap using a simple running stitch.

instructions: Cut out the main wrap and accent strip pieces from the fabric.
Fold and stitch the main wrap piece along the edges.
Attach the accent strip to the main wrap using a simple running stitch.
limitations: The design assumes a plain weave cotton fabric with a weight of 200 gsm.
The fabric requirements are estimates and may vary depending on the actual fabric used.
The assembly instructions are simplified and may require additional steps or adjustments for a professional finish.
